title: Embedding-based semantic RAG: local MiniLM + in-overlay cosine, combined with DAG context
summary: DECISION (user-approved 2026-06-09): upgrade search_knowledge from lexical token-overlap to real semantic retrieval, and wire DAG-targeted context + RAG knowledge search together as the on-task agent's context. Embedding source = LOCAL model (transformers.js + all-MiniLM-L6-v2, ONNX, 384-dim) running in the daemon — free, offline, deterministic, no API key, preserves the self-contained-daemon property; rejected hosted API (Voyage/OpenAI) because it breaks offline/determinism and adds per-call cost to every benchmark run. Storage = plain float arrays stored next to each note in the existing overlay JSON, brute-force in-process cosine at query time (<1ms for thousands of notes); rejected a real vector DB (sqlite-vec/pgvector/Qdrant) as over-engineering at hundreds-to-low-thousands of notes — trivially swappable later if KB passes ~10k. search_knowledge becomes HYBRID: semantic cosine primary, lexical token-overlap (existing scoreNodeAgainstTokens) as fallback when a node has no vector or the model is unavailable. Embed-on-write at record_decision/attach_knowledge/ingest + one-time backfill of existing notes. HYPOTHESIS being tested: DAG-targeted context (dependency summaries + weighted context edges = structural locality) + semantic RAG (associative recall by meaning) together give an on-task agent good context. RETEST scope: v1 (permissive/self-contained spec — agent previously chose not to consult) and v4 (hard task but knowledge was too general) with a combined DAG+RAG arm vs baselines. Tie to benchmark history: search_knowledge was only ever exercised in v5 (confounded by too-easy task); the autonomous loop never calls it at all — it dumps get_learnings. This work fixes both the lexical-not-semantic gap and the retrieval-barely-tested gap.
